decision.reason: [ev-0d3b308e9192] combines four separate changes in one item, each with a different subject and change type: NameConstraints is promoted to beta and enabled by default; UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer is promoted to beta and enabled by default; a new CAInjectorMerging gate is added, and the text does not say it is enabled by default; and the ValidateCAA gate is deprecated, with removal planned for v1.18.0. Because of this, no single typed assertion can be written for subject, change, applicability or consequence. The item needs to be split into one change per feature gate. For the two promotions, the evidence also does not say what happens to installations that do nothing, beyond "enabled by default" and "stops a Kubernetes warning".
